response.sql: WITH per_txn AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per_txn), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt FROM per_txn p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, k.avg_cnt - ka.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka ORDER BY diff_from_kept DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The database is PostgreSQL, inferred from the JSONB columns, the REAL/NUMERIC types, and the FK syntax. AVG returns NUMERIC, so values are not rounded.
AVG skips NULL anlycount values, as the request specifies. A transref whose anlycount values are all NULL has no average, so it is left out of both the overall average and the kept set.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-transaction averages, as the request states. 'Above' is a strict comparison.
Ties at 10th place are cut arbitrarily by LIMIT 10, as the request allows. NULLS LAST is included for the sort, though diff_from_kept cannot be NULL here.
